required_changes_injected: Champion score regression from 4/10 to 2/10 requires explicit documented reason in the analysis itself, not post-hoc justification. The analysis states 'prior 4/10 was inflated' but does not show what changed between the cumulative state and Call 3 to warrant the downgrade. Call 3 evidence (pricing discussion, migration plan request) actually suggests continued engagement. If no contradictory evidence exists, carry-forward rules require maintaining 4/10 and noting 'No new champion information in Call 3 — maintaining previous score of 4/10.' The current 2/10 appears to retroactively redefine the rubric rather than apply it to new call data. Correct by either: (1) restoring 4/10 with explicit note that Call 3 added no contradictory evidence, or (2) providing specific Call 3 evidence that contradicts prior champion assessment and justifies the downgrade within the analysis body, not in a separate justification paragraph.
